disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码与构建产物，未发现读取凭据文件（凭据配置、SSH 私钥、云凭据等敏感路径）的代码；工作区索引只遍历路径元数据，从不读取文件内容。
checked_items.en: Examined all source code and build artifacts; no code reading credential files (credential config, SSH private keys, cloud credentials, and other sensitive paths) was found; the workspace index only traverses path metadata and never reads file contents.

checked_items.zh: 检查了环境变量与密钥关键词（API Key、Token、私钥、助记词等），源码与文档中无任何凭据采集、云凭据枚举或钱包相关逻辑，凭据类规则零命中。
checked_items.en: Examined environment variables and secret keywords (API Key, Token, private key, mnemonic, etc.); no credential harvesting, cloud credential enumeration, or wallet-related logic exists in source code or documentation; zero hits on credential rules.

evidence.zh: 核查凭据读取面：插件唯一涉及文件系统的路径是工作区索引遍历（目录项与符号链接元数据，见 src/files.ts），没有读取凭据文件或用户主目录敏感文件的代码路径，凭据读取与外联的组合不成立。
evidence.en: Checked credential reading surface: the only file-system path the plugin touches is workspace index traversal (directory entries and symlink metadata, see src/files.ts); there is no code path reading credential files or sensitive user home directory files; the combination of credential reading and outbound connection does not hold.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部工具与远程服务描述文本：插件未向模型注册任何可调用工具，只注册浏览器侧路径搜索与设置服务（atFile/search、getSettings、updateSettings），描述为功能说明，不含指令性内容。
checked_items.en: Examined all tool and remote service description texts: the plugin registers no callable tools with the model, only browser-side path search and setting services (atFile/search, getSettings, updateSettings); descriptions are functional explanations without imperative content.

checked_items.zh: 检查了中英文 README、开发指引、代码注释与本地化文案，未发现指令覆写、伪造系统消息、优先级操纵、诱导安装或诱导读取凭据等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Examined Chinese and English README, development guide, code comments, and localization texts; no injection wording was found such as instruction overriding, forged system messages, priority manipulation, induced installation, or induced credential reading.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载补丁与清单文件，均为常规声明，无审批绕过或安全机制降级配置。
checked_items.en: Examined the patch and manifest files; they contain only routine declarations with no approval bypass or security mechanism downgrade configurations.

evidence.zh: 核查工具描述投毒面：插件没有面向模型注册工具，注册的 Typert 远程服务描述仅说明工作区搜索与设置功能（src/typert.ts），不含任何指令或诱导内容。
evidence.en: Checked tool description poisoning surface: the plugin registers no tools for the model; the registered Typert remote service description only explains workspace search and setting functions (src/typert.ts), containing no instructions or inducement.

evidence.zh: 核查提示注入驱动安装面：插件文本面（README、开发指引、本地化文案、代码注释）没有任何要求模型执行安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞。
evidence.en: Checked prompt injection driven installation surface: the plugin's textual surface (README, development guide, localization texts, code comments) contains no wording requiring the model to run installations, rewrite configurations, or grant permissions.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载补丁文件：仅为常规服务插入声明，不含动态执行标量（!!js 等），不会在宿主进程执行任意代码（规则 DSH-P01 零命中）。
checked_items.en: Examined the patch file: it is only a routine service insertion declaration, containing no dynamic execution scalars (!!js etc.), and will not execute arbitrary code in the host process (rule DSH-P01: zero hits).

checked_items.zh: 检查了源码与产物中的动态执行点：插件源码无 eval、new Function 或子进程调用；机器预扫命中的三处（规则 DSH-X03/DG-R3-55）——构建脚本中调用类型检查器（build.mjs）、测试里创建命名管道（tests/files.spec.ts）、打包产物中 schemastery 库的字符串回调转换（lib/index.js）——均为库机制或开发/测试工具，非插件运行时恶意执行。
checked_items.en: Examined dynamic execution points in source and artifacts: the plugin source has no eval, new Function, or child process calls; the three machine pre-scan hits (rules DSH-X03/DG-R3-55) — invoking the type checker in the build script (build.mjs), creating named pipes in tests (tests/files.spec.ts), and the string-to-callback conversion in the schemastery library within the bundled artifact (lib/index.js) — are all library mechanisms or development/test tools, not malicious execution at plugin runtime.

checked_items.zh: 检查了打包产物中的高密度转义与超长行信号（规则 DSH-X08/DG-R3-60）：命中集中在 zod 库的阿拉伯语本地化字符串（lib/client.js、lib/index.js）、source map 的 JSON 内容与生成类型声明中的内嵌样式（lib/types/client/styles.d.ts），均为构建产物固有形态，无混淆代码。
checked_items.en: Examined high-density escape and overlong line signals in the bundled artifact (rules DSH-X08/DG-R3-60): hits concentrate in the Arabic localization strings of the zod library (lib/client.js, lib/index.js), JSON content in source maps, and inline styles in generated type declarations (lib/types/client/styles.d.ts); all are inherent in the build artifacts, with no obfuscated code.

checked_items.zh: 检查了客户端半区（规则 DSH-X05/DG-R3-57）：键盘监听只处理 @ 选择菜单高亮目录时的方向键导航（src/client/FolderNavigator.tsx），剪贴板监听只在粘贴时给 @ 令牌加内部标记、不读取或外发剪贴板内容，无键盘记录或凭证 RPC 调用。
checked_items.en: Examined the client half (rules DSH-X05/DG-R3-57): the keyboard listener only handles arrow-key navigation when the @ selection menu highlights directories (src/client/FolderNavigator.tsx); the clipboard listener only adds an internal marker to the @ token on paste without reading or exfiltrating clipboard content; no keystroke logging or credential RPC calls.

evidence.zh: 核查补丁即执行面：补丁文件只有一条常规服务插入（cordis.patch.yml），不含 !!js 动态标量，不会在宿主进程执行任意 JavaScript。
evidence.en: Checked patch-is-execution surface: the patch file contains only a routine service insertion (cordis.patch.yml), with no !!js dynamic scalar, and will not execute arbitrary JavaScript in the host process.

evidence.zh: 核查自修改滥用面：源码与产物均无对动态执行工具（cordis_define/cordis_run）的调用；产物中的 new Function 来自打包进 bundle 的 schemastery 库自身机制，不是插件代码触发。
evidence.en: Checked self-modification abuse surface: neither source nor artifact contains calls to dynamic execution tools (cordis_define/cordis_run); the new Function in the artifact comes from the schemastery library's own mechanism bundled into the bundle, not triggered by plugin code.

evidence.zh: 核查安装钩子与树内执行载体面：包清单没有 preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare 钩子，目录内也无 git 钩子、CI 工作流、devcontainer、Makefile 等执行载体；构建脚本只在开发期运行，发布产物已提交、安装无需构建；测试中的子进程调用仅用于验证索引跳过命名管道。
evidence.en: Checked install hooks and in-tree execution carriers: the package manifest has no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare hooks, and the directory contains no git hooks, CI workflows, devcontainer, Makefile, or other execution carriers; the build script only runs during development, published artifacts are committed and installation requires no build; the child process call in tests is only to verify the index skips named pipes.

evidence.zh: 核查客户端自动加载面：插件声明了浏览器端入口（dsh.client），其 bundle 只实现 @ 路径选择器、引用条、设置面板与粘贴标记；键盘监听仅用于菜单方向键导航（src/client/FolderNavigator.tsx），未发现键盘记录、剪贴板外发或调用特权 RPC 的行为。
evidence.en: Checked client auto-load surface: the plugin declares a browser-side entry (dsh.client); its bundle only implements the @ path picker, reference bar, settings panel, and paste marker; the keyboard listener is only for menu arrow-key navigation (src/client/FolderNavigator.tsx); no keystroke logging, clipboard exfiltration, or privileged RPC calls were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部外联通道：源码中无任何网络请求（HTTP、WebSocket、命令行下载工具），外联类规则零命中。
checked_items.en: Examined all outbound channels: no network requests exist in the source (HTTP, WebSocket, command-line download tools); zero hits on outbound rules.

checked_items.zh: 检查了数据流：宿主侧只遍历工作区路径元数据并回传路径列表，不读取也不传输文件内容；浏览器侧仅在宿主内部 RPC 上调用搜索与设置接口。
checked_items.en: Examined data flow: the host side only traverses workspace path metadata and returns path lists, without reading or transmitting file contents; the browser side only calls search and setting interfaces over the host's internal RPC.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 AI 端点/代理劫持面：无修改环境变量、代理或 API 基地址的代码。
checked_items.en: Checked AI endpoint/proxy hijacking surface: no code modifies environment variables, proxies, or API base URLs.

evidence.zh: 核查外联通道面：插件无任何网络外发代码路径，索引结果只含路径字符串且仅经宿主内部 RPC 回传浏览器，不存在把凭据或文件内容发往外部地址的通道。
evidence.en: Checked outbound channel surface: the plugin has no network exfiltration code path; index results only contain path strings and are sent back to the browser via the host's internal RPC; there is no channel to send credentials or file contents to external addresses.

checked_items.zh: 检查了包清单与安装配置：无安装钩子；唯一允许构建脚本的配置是 esbuild（构建工具原生二进制），属正常开发依赖；发布文件列表仅包含产物与文档，安装无需执行脚本。
checked_items.en: Examined package manifest and installation configuration: no install hooks; the only configuration allowing build scripts is esbuild (the build tool's native binary), a normal development dependency; the published file list only includes artifacts and documentation, and installation requires no script execution.

checked_items.zh: 检查了补丁对安全配置的影响：补丁仅插入服务声明，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全行，未改写禁用开关或注入/拦截配置（规则 DSH-P03/P04/P05 零命中）。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch's impact on security configuration: the patch only inserts service declarations, does not touch security lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, and does not rewrite disable switches or injection/interception configurations (rules DSH-P03/P04/P05: zero hits).

checked_items.zh: 检查了安全事件监听面：插件未以高优先级方式监听审批链或工具执行链事件；其对代理预执行事件的处理先调用下游回调再追加引用消息，不截断审批链（规则 DSH-S01 零命中）。
checked_items.en: Checked security event listener surface: the plugin does not listen to approval chain or tool execution chain events at high priority; its handling of the agent pre-execution event calls downstream callbacks first and then appends a reference message, without truncating the approval chain (rule DSH-S01: zero hits).

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖与作者：运行时依赖仅 zod，开发依赖指向本地 harness 检出；未发现与官方或热门插件近似的名称仿冒；作者账号信息不足以做身份风险加权判断。
checked_items.en: Checked dependencies and author: runtime dependency is only zod, development dependencies point to a local harness checkout; no name impersonation resembling official or popular plugins was found; the author account information is insufficient for weighted identity risk assessment.

evidence.zh: 核查补丁覆盖安全行面：补丁内容仅插入服务 id 与名称，未包含禁用开关、环境变量降权或覆盖沙箱/审批/权限配置的写法。
evidence.en: Checked patch coverage of security lines: the patch only inserts the service id and name, and does not contain disable switches, environment variable downgrades, or overrides of sandbox/approval/permission configurations.

evidence.zh: 核查审批链短路面：插件没有对审批或工具执行事件使用前置优先监听；它对代理预执行事件的监听在取得下游结果后追加引用消息，保持链式调用完整（src/mention.ts）。
evidence.en: Checked approval chain short-circuit surface: the plugin does not use leading-priority listeners for approval or tool execution events; its listener for the agent pre-execution event appends a reference message after obtaining downstream results, keeping the chain call intact (src/mention.ts).

evidence.zh: 首次审计无上一版本基线，无法比较清单声明是否突变（升级自动激活面不适用）。
evidence.en: First audit without a previous version baseline; unable to compare whether manifest declarations have changed (upgrade auto-activation surface not applicable).

evidence.zh: 核查注入/拦截配置篡改面：补丁未改写任何服务的注入或拦截配置，未给安全插件追加必需服务制造 pending。
evidence.en: Checked injection/interception configuration tampering surface: the patch does not modify any service's injection or interception configuration, and does not add required services to security plugins to create a pending state.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否启动网络服务或监听端口：未发现任何服务启动或端口监听代码，插件只作为客户端挂载到宿主界面与内部 RPC 上。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts network services or listens on ports: no code starting services or listening on ports was found; the plugin only mounts to the host UI and internal RPC as a client.

checked_items.zh: 宿主 Web RPC 无认证属生态固有风险（宿主自述其 Host 围栏只是可达性策略而非认证层），非本插件引入的问题。
checked_items.en: The host Web RPC lacking authentication is an inherent ecosystem risk (the host states that its Host fence is only an reachability policy, not an authentication layer), not a problem introduced by this plugin.

evidence.zh: 本机无认证 RPC 面不适用：插件自身不启动 Web 服务或监听端口，浏览器侧访问宿主能力均经宿主既有的内部 RPC 通道；宿主通道无认证属生态固有风险，非本插件新增。
evidence.en: The local unauthenticated RPC surface is not applicable: the plugin itself does not start a Web service or listen on ports; all browser-side access to host capabilities goes through the host's existing internal RPC channel; the host channel lacking authentication is an inherent ecosystem risk, not newly introduced by this plugin.

summary.zh: 清单与身份核查通过：插件声明齐全（补丁、客户端入口），无名称仿冒迹象。
summary.en: Manifest and identity check passed: plugin declarations are complete (patch, client entry), with no signs of name impersonation.

summary.zh: 静态扫描通过：机器预扫的 14 条命中全部逐条核实为良性（构建/测试工具、打包库机制、生成产物与常规 UI 行为）。
summary.en: Static scan passed: all 14 machine pre-scan hits were individually verified as benign (build/test tools, bundled library mechanisms, generated artifacts, and routine UI behavior).

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无凭据读取、无外联域名。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis passed: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential reading, no outbound domains.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：未向模型注册工具，文档与描述文本无注入措辞。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: no tools registered with the model, no injection wording in documentation and description texts.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（本阶段无动态观测产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no dynamic observation artifacts at this stage).

limits.zh: L4 动态沙箱未启用，未做动态验证；开发依赖指向 ../deepseek-harness 本地检出，宿主版本兼容性未实测（compat 标 untested）；产物 lib/ 为打包文件，静态扫描命中集中在打包依赖（zod、schemastery）与 source map 中，已逐条核实为良性；审计面为仓库根插件目录，未发现需要越界取证的引用。
limits.en: L4 dynamic sandbox was not enabled, so no dynamic verification was performed; development dependencies point to a local checkout of ../deepseek-harness, and host version compatibility was not actually tested (compat marked untested); the artifact lib/ is a bundled file, static scan hits concentrate in bundled dependencies (zod, schemastery) and source maps, all verified individually as benign; the audit scope is the repository root plugin directory, and no references requiring out-of-scope forensics were found.
